narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Departure Board"**

The dashboard is a station concourse. A brushed-steel ground carries a graphite rail, white working sheets for money and evidence, and one matte split-flap board where every coin both bots watch is a row. A row's status flips through the flaps and its WAITING FOR column names the next thing that has to happen, so "why not" is read off the board. Clicking a row drops a white trace sheet into the board with the checks in order.

Density is concourse density: an all-day second-monitor tab that reads at a glance and rewards a closer look. Barlow Condensed caps carry everything mechanical; Barlow carries sentences and figures, all with tabular numerals.

The world rejects the KPI-tile trading terminal and the P&L-first equity chart.
keyCharacteristics: Brushed-steel ground with fine horizontal grain, graphite rail, white sheets, one flap board.
Two-leaf flap cells split by a hairline with hinge pins, folding only on change.
Four-state signal (white, amber, green, red) carried by flap lettering and a row lamp.
Condensed caps for machinery, a plain grotesque for sentences.
Only two writing controls: Pause and Flatten, news bot only.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Signal Rule
rules.body: Every signal color has a flap voice (bright, on black) and a paper voice (dark ink on its wash, on white). Never cross them.

rules.name: The Lamp Not Panel Rule
rules.body: Row state lives in the lamp, the STATUS flaps and a faint same-hue row tint; sheets, board and rail never change color with state.

rules.name: The Caps Are Machinery Rule
rules.body: Uppercase condensed type is for flaps, controls, nav, column heads and labels; sentences are always Barlow in sentence case.

rules.name: The Count-In-Cells Rule
rules.body: Board columns are measured in flap characters via --cw; values are padded or truncated to the count.

rules.name: The Paper On Steel Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and ambient; no hard offsets, no glows beyond the lamp halo and heartbeat ring.

dos: Do size every board column in flap characters.
Do name the next required event in WAITING FOR in plain words.
Do use flap colors on black and ink-on-wash colors on white.
Do fold only changed characters, with leaves created for the fold and removed after.
Do write the final character directly under reduced motion.
Do keep money statements as plain sentences.
Do keep Flatten a red outline; filled red only on its confirm.
donts: Don't add KPI tiles, sparklines or an equity chart above the board.
Don't color sheets, the board housing or the rail by state.
Don't set sentences in condensed caps or flap lettering in Barlow.
Don't leave will-change or idle animation on flap cells.
Don't add writing controls beyond Pause and Flatten.
Don't use hard offset shadows or decorative glows.
